GPU computation of partial sums to 10^10 terms, explicitly non-proof empirical evidence

judgement.doubts: The record's `event` field (dated to the Sep 2026 withdrawal) and credited_humans are left as evidence; no surviving event sets the status. The 2603.09719 criterion is an equivalent reformulation that bounds nothing, so it is `none`, not `bound`.

corrections.why: F6/F3: the only whole claim (arXiv:2502.03474) was withdrawn by its co-author for specific errors; the record itself says 2603.09719 is 'an equivalence/reformulation of the open question rather than a settlement of any case', which is scope none, not a bound; Dan's paper is a variant and the 10^10 partial sums are instances. Nothing survives step 1, so the status is open.
